description.narrative:
Women need to be engaged in developing and implementing all aspects of climate change mitigation and adaptation for sustainable development to be fully realized. In Uganda women and youth have an important role in agriculture and natural resource management, but also have greater financial and resource constraints and limited access to information and resources as compared to men. Women especially face unique challenges in maintaining sustainable livelihoods in the face of climate change due to gender inequality.
Simultaneously, climate change has resulted in erratic and unpredictable rainfall and the onset, duration, and intensity of rains vary considerably from year to year affecting agriculture production. Land degradation, poor soil, high dependence on rain-fed agriculture has been a big stumbling block to the efforts of the Ugandan government and NGOs to increase household food security and income. The impacts of COVID-19 and climate change have also exacerbated food insecurity and increased the need for urgent interventions to improve household food security and livelihoods.
For this project, Oxfam will support 150 women smallholder farmers to enhance their capacity in climate-smart agriculture practices to maximize their productivity and increase nutrition and income. This work will fully engage women and youth so they are part of the solution in mitigating climate change and increasing food security.

participating-org.narrative: Oxfam Novib is one of the 17 national affiliates of the Oxfam International Confederation. It started life in 1956 as the Netherlands Organisation for International Assistance (Novib), and joined forces with Oxfam in 1994. Working together in confederation, the Oxfam affiliates can speak with one clear and compelling voice on issues of global concern: climate change, health and education forall, agriculture, trade, and conflicts and emergencies. Oxfam established this country office to support local organizations and projects. Through this local office Oxfam Novib directly contributes towards this project’s implementation.
